messages:
nina: Heads-up: hiring managers are reporting that they can't see scorecards for the interviews conducted yesterday. They get a 403 when opening the scorecard link.

own: Yep—saw 2 PMs ping me. I opened one link and got "Permission denied: role mismatch". I assumed caching, but multiple hiring managers across teams.

devon: Reproduced. The ATS API returns 403 with body: 
```
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "reason": "role_id mismatch: expected=role_hiring_manager got=role_interviewer"
}
```

rachel: Any recent HRIS/role syncs? We had the weekly HRIS->ATS push last night. Could be a mapping change.

ats-sync-bot: HRIS sync job 2026-04-02T02:00:12Z completed. Changed role mapping for external_role_id E-482 -> role_interviewer. Audit record: https://redwood.internal/hris/audit/2026-04-02-0200

nina: That link explains a lot. Looks like previously E-482 mapped to role_hiring_manager for contract PMs; sync overwrite swapped them to interviewer. Hiring managers who are contractors lost manager access.

own: We need a quick fix — reverting mapping or add a special-case in the scorecard ACL check to treat E-482 as manager for now. What's less risky?

devon: Revert in HRIS mapping is bigger change (affects payroll exports). Quick mitigation: adjust ATS permission logic to allow contract PMs with E-482 to view scorecards until ops resolves mapping. I'll draft a small feature-flagged patch.

rachel: Also we should notify impacted candidates/hiring teams if any offer processes were blocked. Nina, can you surface a list?

nina: On it. Querying ATS for interviews with participants having external_role_id=E-482 in last 72h.

ats-sync-bot: Query results: 12 panels affected across 7 roles, 9 unique hiring managers. Generated CSV: https://redwood.internal/reports/ats-roleid-e482-20260402.csv

nina: Uploaded cleanup ticket and CSV to hiring-ops: https://redwood.internal/tickets/HRIS-4123. I'll run a manual backfill to restore hiring_manager role on those 9 accounts after patch lands.

own: ETA on patch, Devon? We need minimal blast radius and a rollback plan.

devon: Patch ready (feature flag on). Deploying to staging now. If tests pass, can go to prod in ~25m with a 15m maintenance window. Rollback: flip feature flag off. I'll include migration to mark affected profiles as 'legacy-manager' until HRIS mapping is resolved.

rachel: Action items for postmortem: 1) Add pre-sync validation to warn if role mappings change for external_role_ids that are attached to active panels, 2) Run a one-off audit to catch similar collisions quarterly, 3) Add a KB article for recruiters on how to check role mappings. I'll create the ticket and assign.

own: Thanks team. Nina please alert the 9 hiring managers once we're live with the mitigation so they can confirm visibility.

devon: Deployed to prod behind flag. Patch enabled. Quick smoke: opened 3 sample scorecards as manager — now accessible. Leaving flag on for 24h and monitoring.

nina: Confirmed with 6/9 hiring managers — scorecards visible. Will follow up with the other 3.

rachel: Great. After the HRIS owners revert mapping we'll remove the mitigation and run the proper backfill. I'll loop in HRIS owners in HR channel.

ats-sync-bot: Monitoring: no new 403s for scorecard access in last 30m. Alert rule placed: trigger if >2 role_id mismatch errors for scorecard endpoints in 1h.
